summary: Full E2E testing of iteration 10 (teacher password reset + parent card email). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passing (create returns email_sent; reset admin OK; new password works via login + old rejected; non-admin teacher gets 403; non-existent id -> 404; reset on parent id -> 404; 10 consecutive resets produce >=8 unique passwords matching pattern Word+Word+3digits+!; parent object exposes email). Frontend: box '@ NOME UTENTE PER IL LOGIN' is removed from teacher cards; reset-pwd-{id} buttons present (6 teachers); clicking reset shows window.confirm, then POST /api/teachers/{id}/reset-password succeeds and the 'Password rigenerata ✓' modal renders with copy-r-email + copy-r-pwd and the Chiudi button (reset-close) closes it; banner color is amber as expected because Brevo API key is 'not enabled' (email_sent=false). Parents page: parent card exposes AtSign + email in font-mono with data-testid='parent-login-{id}'. Cleanup performed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:822 — _send_credentials_mail returns False on any exception, which keeps the create/reset endpoints resilient to Brevo outages. Good. Consider surfacing the error reason (not just a bool) back to the UI so the amber banner can hint 'API key disabled' vs 'network error'.

backend/server.py:826 _generate_readable_password uses 12 words and 900 numeric values => ~130k combinations. For 10 resets the collision probability is tiny (observed 10/10 unique). Fine for the current use-case but adding a 3rd dictionary or a symbol pool would make brute-force audit trails even stronger.

frontend Teachers.jsx:57 — window.confirm is used for the destructive reset action. Works but a styled Modal confirmation would be more consistent with the rest of the UI (which uses in-app modals everywhere else).
test_credentials: admin@scuolapp.it / Admin2026! used. maestra.giulia@scuolapp.it password was rotated during FE test (new pwd no longer stored); test teacher test.iter10.reset@scuolapp.it created and deleted; test parent via backend created and cleaned up at end.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed changes. All test teachers/parents were removed after the run. Note: maestra.giulia password is now the one generated by the last reset in FE test and is not persisted anywhere — the credentials file already flags her password as invalidated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_10 validated: (1) teacher card redesign removed '@ NOME UTENTE PER IL LOGIN' box and keeps email as subtitle, (2) new POST /api/teachers/{id}/reset-password endpoint behaves correctly (RBAC, 404s, uniqueness, E2E login), (3) reset modal shows amber banner when Brevo email fails (expected), (4) parent card shows email via data-testid='parent-login-{id}' with AtSign + font-mono. Brevo key is still 'not enabled' at the account level — email_sent=false is the expected production state until the user enables the Brevo API key.
